raw_response:
I farm these 12 mu the old way, by what I have seen on my own land and what the nearby families do. Wheat and maize is the steady road here. I am not going to gamble on fancy things. Wheat still needs enough base fertilizer and a topdressing, otherwise the leaves turn yellow and the heads stay light. Maize has to go in fast after wheat harvest, so I will keep the ground work simple and not waste days. Water from the well costs money, so I will not irrigate too many times, only at the stages that matter most. Some people in my house work outside, so family labor is not always fully free. I would rather spend a bit on seed and fertilizer than lose yield, but I still have to watch every yuan.
